requirements:
**R07.5 切换任务与后台页面**
- 页面由主进程持有，按任务常驻。切换任务、收起工作区、关闭文件面板都不销毁页面，也不中断在途命令。
- 任务切到后台时，页面移入停放窗口：已显示但完全透明、不可聚焦、不接收鼠标、不出现在任务栏和窗口菜单。页面保持原尺寸继续绘制，切回时再挂回右侧工作区。这样做是因为页面不绘制时点击会变慢、截图会卡住。
- 用户看不到、也点不到停放窗口。Agent 只能看到目标页面，看不到停放窗口和 WillYou 界面。
rssCriterion: RSS30*100 <= RSS10*110, exact integer bytes; sum resident memory over all owned App processes, shared pages are not deduplicated
lastFourCriterion: RSS at15/20/25/30 not all three successive deltas strictly positive; raw values unchanged; any ambiguity or excess requires analysis
cpuCriterion: Actual per-process user+system CPU cumulative differences over monotonic intervals;100%=one logical core, never divide by CPU count. Idle intervals must not overlap actual scheduled command activity; all idle samples retained, unexplained peaks not excluded. Unknown exited-process final counters explicitly flagged, not silently treated as zero.
